set.body:
Scope: Independent consumer fixtures and clean checkout acceptance for the exact final provider revisions.

Deliverable: Run standalone provider consumers and the functional-analysis, MVPA, atlas/searchlight, surface readback and linked-frame scenarios against immutable pins without sibling overrides or local artifact leakage.

Acceptance:
- Independent mvpa4s and neurosurf4s consumers build/test without ScalaFIM or provider test internals.
- ScalaFIM compile-all plus bounded JVM/JS regression batches pass; native and browser evidence is separately recorded.
- All five scenario families in plan section 7 return explicit results; known caveats, skipped real assets and adverse evidence are retained. Record exact revisions and raw exit status; do not infer publication or new scientific qualification.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U6: Verify clean independent consumers and end-to-end ScalaFIM workflows
